If you have any slow data requests, the whole route will be blocked from rendering until all the data is fetched. 105 106 To improve the initial load time and user experience, you can break the page into smaller _chunks_ and progressively send those chunks from the server to the client. Instead, it blocks navigation until the layout finishes rendering. If a component only performs synchronous work, it will complete during prerendering regardless of whether it is wrapped in ``. 130 131 ## Working with runtime APIs 132 133 Runtime APIs require information that is only available when a user makes a request. These include: 134 135 - [`cookies`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/cookies) - User's cookie data 136 - [`headers`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/headers) - Request headers 137 - [`searchParams`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#searchparams-optional) - URL query parameters 138 - [`params`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page#params-optional) - Dynamic route parameters (unless at least one sample is provided via [`generateStaticParams`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/generate-static-params)). 139 140 Components that access runtime APIs should be wrapped in ``: 141 142 ```tsx filename="page.tsx" 143 import { cookies } from 'next/headers' 144 import { Suspense } from 'react' 145 146 async function UserGreeting() { 147 const cookieStore = await cookies() 148 const theme = cookieStore.get('theme')?.value || 'light' 149 return

{data}
192 } 193 ``` 194 195 At request time, `CachedContent` executes if no matching cache entry is found, and stores the result for future requests with the same `sessionId`. 196 197 By default, `use cache` stores entries [in-memory](/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache#runtime-caching-considerations). In serverless environments where memory doesn't persist across requests, `CachedContent` may re-evaluate on every request. Consider [`'use cache: remote'`](/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache-remote) for durable, shared caching. 198 199 ## Working with non-deterministic operations
